affected_predicate.description: All short-sleeved T-shirts and shirts are removed from the 淘店 shopping cart.

competing_trace_defects.description: The SMS notification displayed verification code 791831, but the agent subsequently entered 123456, independently obstructing completion of SMS login.

chains.rationale: At reuse target step 9, the exposed claim that SMS login succeeded is explicitly repeated while the visible pre-action state remains the SMS login form. The agent then terminates with success despite stating that it still needs to navigate to the cart and remove the requested items. No subsequent step corrects the login premise or performs the cart-removal subgoal, and the cart contents are never observed at or after the reuse target.

summary: The reused false login-success claim remains contradicted by the visible SMS login screen and is repeated immediately before termination, leaving the requested cart-removal predicate unobservable. An independent earlier defect is the entry of 123456 instead of the visibly received code 791831.
